mission.briefing: Establish contact, document the declared Utility Room conditions, maintain the field record, and return through the confirmed Threshold route.
mission.operational_intent: Produce a grounded survey record while retaining personnel, equipment, evidence, route, and communication accountability.

public.inactive: The Standard radio-check phase has not begun.
public.active: Standard has not yet acknowledged the field radio check.
public.blocked: The assigned field radio is not available for contact.
public.satisfied: Standard acknowledged the field team and authorized departure.
public.failed: The assigned field radio was lost before contact was established.
public.waived: The controlled abort record notes that Standard could not be reached.
public.abandoned: Radio contact was not established before mission closure.
public.next_requirement: Complete the visible radio check and receive Standard acknowledgment.

public.blocked: Field entry remains dependent on acknowledged radio contact.
public.active: The team has not yet entered the assigned survey area.
public.satisfied: The team physically entered the declared Utility Room survey area.
public.failed: The survey area became unavailable before entry.
public.abandoned: The team closed the mission without entering the survey area.
public.next_requirement: Traverse the authorized field route into the Utility Room.

public.inactive: The declared Utility Room is not yet part of the current field record.
public.blocked: The Utility Room survey cannot proceed until the team enters the assigned area.
public.active: The fixture, floor scuffs, and service panel are not yet all established, and one feature still needs validation.
public.satisfied: The declared fixture, floor, and panel conditions are known and at least one feature was validated.
public.failed: A required Utility Room condition can no longer be established.
public.waived: The missing Utility Room condition was explicitly waived.
public.abandoned: The Utility Room survey remained incomplete at mission closure.
public.next_requirement: Inspect the fixture, floor scuffs, and service panel, then test, open, or mark one declared feature.

public.inactive: Evidence collection has not begun in the field.
public.blocked: Evidence collection depends on entering the assigned area.
public.active: No valid object-specific field record has been captured.
public.satisfied: At least one valid condition-specific field record is retained.
public.failed: The recording device was lost before a valid record was captured.
public.abandoned: No valid field evidence was retained at mission closure.
public.next_requirement: Use an authored recording or measurement procedure on a visible object.

public.inactive: No captured field evidence is ready for reporting.
public.blocked: The evidence report cannot proceed under the current known conditions.
public.dependency_blocked: A valid object-specific field record is required before a report can be sent.
public.condition_blocked: A field record exists, but the Standard radio channel is unavailable.
public.active: A valid field record is retained. Standard has not yet received it.
public.satisfied: Standard received a report tied to the retained field evidence.
public.failed: The reporting opportunity closed before Standard received the record.
public.waived: The closure record notes that communication was unavailable.
public.abandoned: Retained evidence was not reported before mission closure.
public.next_requirement: Transmit a report that identifies the retained evidence or its observed subject.

public.inactive: The field return route has not yet been entered.
public.blocked: The declared return route cannot currently be verified.
public.active: The Threshold-side marker has not yet been verified and secured.
public.satisfied: The Threshold-side marker is secured on the traversed return route.
public.failed: The known return connection is no longer available.
public.abandoned: The return marker remained unsecured at mission closure.
public.next_requirement: Return to the Threshold-side entry, inspect the marker, and secure it with marker supplies.

public.inactive: No field check-in is currently scheduled.
public.blocked: The scheduled report cannot be transmitted while communication is unavailable.
public.active: The scheduled check-in remains pending within its declared window.
public.satisfied: Standard received the scheduled field check-in.
public.failed: The declared check-in window passed without a delivered report.
public.waived: The missed window was waived because the field radio was unavailable.
public.abandoned: The scheduled check-in remained unresolved at mission closure.
public.next_requirement: Transmit a field-status check-in to Standard before the scheduled window closes.

public.inactive: No return or controlled abort has been requested.
public.blocked: Assigned personnel are not currently accounted for on the return route.
public.active: The return procedure is underway; reach the Threshold-side entry and reconcile the team, equipment, and field record.
public.satisfied: The team reached the Threshold-side entry and equipment and field-record outcomes were reconciled.
public.failed: Return accountability can no longer be established.
public.abandoned: The mission closed without verified return accountability.
public.next_requirement: Follow the known route to the Threshold-side entry with personnel, equipment, and evidence accounted for.

public.inactive: The optional second record becomes available after the first valid evidence item.
public.blocked: A first valid field record is required before expanding the evidence set.
public.active: One field condition is documented; a second distinct object record remains optional.
public.satisfied: Distinct conditions from at least two field objects were documented.
public.failed: The recording device was lost before a second distinct condition could be documented.
public.abandoned: The team returned without a second distinct object record.
public.next_requirement: Capture valid evidence from a second authored field object.

public.unavailable: No confirmed field-to-Threshold route is available from the current record.
public.available: A known route returns to the Threshold, but required field work remains unresolved.
public.ready: The route is known and required field work is resolved; the team may begin return.
public.requested: Return procedure begun. Reach the Threshold-side entry before closing the mission.
public.closure_requested: Return accountability is being reconciled with Standard.
public.closure_unavailable: Reach the declared return point with personnel, equipment, and retained records accounted for before closing the mission.

abort_policy.public_reason: Controlled abort declared. Unresolved field objectives are abandoned while return accountability remains active.
abort_policy.public_unavailable: This mission record is already closed.

outcome_rules.public_summary: The team completed a controlled abort and returned with the accountability that remained available.
The team returned with the required survey, reporting, route, and accountability record plus an additional documented condition.
The team returned with the required survey, evidence, reporting, route, and accountability conditions resolved.
The team returned and closed the mission, but one or more required survey, evidence, route, equipment, or communication conditions remained incomplete.
The mission closed without establishing return accountability.

known_limitations: Clear-Q4 contains one compact authored mission slice; broader hazards and autonomous personnel policy remain deferred.
A single scheduled field check-in is evaluated in this milestone.
